confidence_notes: Overall low confidence. Trinidad-specific 2026 price data was sparse. Food and drink anchors rest on Cuba-wide 2026 traveller ranges for peso restaurants, paladares and tourist bars, plus older undated Trinidad guides, and Cuban prices are changing quickly. Cocktail (about 1.6 times beer) and wine glass (about 1.8 times beer) are set from the local beer relationship because direct evidence was weak. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Cuban casa particular and hotel pricing; no live booking pages or current listings were checked, and the hostel dorm anchor is the least grounded. It is not confirmed as the latest RBA observation available on 2026-11-19, so refresh it from the RBA daily table before use.
